_comment: Tunable cost model for Signal Stacking run estimation. All token figures are per-unit estimates of TOTAL billed tokens (input + output split out so a $ figure can be computed). Consumed by scripts/costlib.py. Edit the numbers here, never in the code.

triage._comment: One prospect-triage subagent (Haiku model, .claude/agents/prospect-triage.md). Budget-capped at max 3 Exa searches. Input: agent prompt + seller-context (~4-5k) + up to 3 search results (~3-4k each = ~12k) + scoring script output and loop re-reads => ~20k in. Output: reasoning + tool calls + the compact TRIAGE block => ~1.5k out.

deep_dive._comment: One prospect-researcher subagent (main model, .claude/agents/prospect-researcher.md). Dominated by search-result ingestion: 6 lenses x 3-4 searches = ~20-22 searches x ~6k result tokens (~130k) + page fetches — homepage, careers, and for public companies the 10-K/10-Q/proxy, which are large — ~4 x ~14k (~56k) + agent prompt, seller-context, and accumulated-context re-reads (~45k) => ~225k in. Output: the brief now carries filings-with-opportunity, exec/C-suite/board voice and market-opportunity sections (~3.5k tokens) + tool-call args, scoring and the summary block => ~15k out. Private companies land lower (no filings lens); this is the public-co case.

refresh_multiplier._comment: A `refresh` run passes the old brief stamp so the researcher searches only the delta ('signals since <date>') instead of redoing all four lenses => ~60% of a full deep dive (fewer searches, but the brief is still rewritten in full).

orchestrator._comment: The /signal-stacking orchestrator itself (.claude/commands/signal-stacking.md). Base: command file + seller-context read + Exa lane discovery + task tracking + dashboard build + roll-up (~15k in / 3k out). Per account: CSV row parse, prompt construction, compact summary-block ingestion, index row (~0.9k in / 0.3k out each). Billed at main-model rates.

survival_rate_default._comment: Default fraction of triaged accounts whose verdict is DEEP_DIVE (rest PARK/SKIP/CLARIFY). The triage pass is designed to 'kill the dead half of the list', so ~0.5 for a typical raw account list. Callers can override per-run.

fresh_skip._comment: Accounts with a brief fresher than 14 days are skipped free on non-refresh runs (only the tiny per-account orchestrator overhead applies). On a refresh run they are re-searched at the refresh multiplier.

pricing_usd_per_mtok._comment: REFERENCE ONLY: Claude API list prices per million tokens (as of Aug 2026). Triage runs on Haiku (Claude Haiku 4.5: $1 in / $5 out). 'main' = the session's main model for the orchestrator + deep dives; Claude Opus 5 list price ($5 in / $25 out) is used as the reference. Subscription (Claude Code plan) users are NOT billed these amounts - treat the $ figure as a relative-cost yardstick only. If the repo runs on Sonnet-class, swap main to 3.00/15.00.
